selection_rationale: Random Forest is deployed to production despite Logistic Regression scoring marginally higher on cross-validated ROC-AUC (0.780 vs. 0.774 — a difference smaller than the fold-to-fold variance observed for either model, so it isn't a reliable signal on a dataset this size). Random Forest was retained because averaging many trees over bootstrapped samples tends to generalize more consistently on small, noisy tabular data than a single model fit once, and its feature_importances_ are used directly by this app's explainability page. Full candidate scores: Logistic Regression: 0.780 (±0.006), Decision Tree: 0.754 (±0.008), Gradient Boosting: 0.776 (±0.006), Random Forest: 0.774 (±0.005).
